test: Limited offline Arabic recording-to-text-to-ROS physical LED demonstration

final_recognizer.processing: Native 16 kHz mono PCM array input; no PyAV file decoding

capture.note: An earlier calibration used 15 seconds; all subsequent captures used five seconds as explicitly requested. Existing clips were reused for model comparisons.

observed_off.physical_sequence: Operator announced the test, turned the LED on through ROS, and replayed the existing OFF recording through ASR and ROS.

failed_or_rejected_attempts.note: Prompt-related recognition error on a quiet clip

audio_feedback: User listened to a local diagnostic clip and clarified that the recording was weak, rather than necessarily truncated.
command_policy: Explicit normalized Arabic phrases only; nominal forms تشغيل اللمبة and إطفاء اللمبة were added. No fuzzy matching of incorrect transcripts.
software_checks: 14 portable tests passed, including unknown/negated/combined phrase rejection and bounded PCM amplification without integer wraparound.
final_state: physical LED off; microphone recording stopped
limitations: Two successful recordings do not establish general dialect accuracy or reliability.
OFF succeeded after replay of an existing clip with software gain and an experimental confidence threshold of 0.3; the CLI default remains 0.8.
Confidence scores are model estimates, not calibrated probabilities of correctness.
The nominal OFF phrase was accepted; repeated direct recognition of the colloquial طف phrase was unsuccessful.
No successful fresh live capture was demonstrated with the final gain/threshold profile.
No always-listening or wake-word system was tested.
Pi 4 and other microphones/dialects remain untested.
privacy: Audio stayed on the user's Pi and laptop. Recordings and personal utterances are not included in this repository record. No cloud transcription was used.
